title.zh: Harmony Proposes Sunsetting Network and Moving ONE to Ethereum for AI Video Pivot
title.en: Harmony Proposes Sunsetting Network and Moving ONE to Ethereum for AI Video Pivot

current_state.zh: Harmony proposes sunsetting its network, snapshotting ONE at the final block, and redirecting emissions to an AI video business, urging users to exit smart contracts before Sept. 10.
